title: Lautaro passes Agüero, alone in third for Argentina
description: Inter beat Lumezzane 2–0 behind closed doors on Saturday, with Djed Spence playing his first minutes for the club, and Inter Women are at Como this afternoon.
mast_alt: Nerazzurri Daily Edition No. 33, Sunday, October 4, 2026 — Lautaro passes Agüero, alone in third for Argentina

blocks.html: Lautaro Martínez scored after four minutes in Argentina's 7–0 friendly win over Burkina Faso on Saturday night. It was his 42nd goal for his country, and it leaves him alone in third place on Argentina's all-time list, one ahead of Sergio Agüero. Earlier on Saturday Inter beat Lumezzane 2–0 behind closed doors at Appiano Gentile, Inter's training ground, and Djed Spence played his first minutes for the club.

blocks.h3: Lautaro Martínez goes third on his own in Argentina's history
paras: Lautaro Martínez, the Inter captain and forward, opened the scoring in the fourth minute at the Monumental on Saturday night. The goalkeeper saved his penalty, and he turned in the rebound with his left foot. He came off at halftime for Tomás Palacios, the Inter defender on loan at Estudiantes.

It was his 42nd goal in 86 games for Argentina, and his fourth in four games. He is now one clear of Sergio Agüero, the former Argentina forward, in third place on his country's all-time list. Only Gabriel Batistuta, with 55 goals, and Lionel Messi, with 125, are ahead. Some Italian papers wrote that he had only drawn level; the club credits Agüero with 41.

blocks.h3: Akanji wins again with Switzerland; Sucic is caught in a rout
paras: Manuel Akanji, the Inter center back, played all 90 minutes on Saturday as Switzerland came from behind to beat Slovenia 2–1. Petar Sucic, the Inter midfielder, started and played 45 minutes as Croatia lost 7–0 at home to England in Rijeka. Ange-Yoan Bonny, the Inter forward, played 45 minutes in Ivory Coast's 1–0 friendly defeat by Cameroon.

blocks.h3: Inter Women are at Como this afternoon
paras: Inter Women are away at Como Women today, 12:00 PM ET (18:00 CEST), in matchday 2 of Serie A Women. Their last game was Thursday's 1–1 draw at Austria Wien in the Women's Champions League. Ivana Andrés, the Inter Women defender, equalized there in the 93rd minute.

blocks.h3: Gazzetta dello Sport: Inter want to extend Bastoni past 2028
paras: Gazzetta dello Sport, Italy's biggest sports daily, reports that Inter intend to open talks on a new contract for Alessandro Bastoni, the Inter center back. His current deal runs to 2028, and the paper says Inter want to keep him "fino oltre il 2028" — beyond 2028. A sale looked possible in the spring, at about 60 million euros.

blocks.h3: Gazzetta dello Sport: Spence should be in the squad at last
paras: The same paper reports that Djed Spence, the defender Inter signed in the summer, should finally be named in the squad for Parma next Saturday. He played 50 minutes in the friendly and could make his Serie A debut. Inter are encouraged, the paper says, although "il ritmo partita" — match sharpness — will take time.

paras: Henrikh Mkhitaryan, the Inter midfielder, scored first, and Richi Agbonifo, a forward from Inter's Under-23 team, added the second in a game of two 35-minute halves.
